fields.name: query_id
fields.description: Deterministic stable ID (q001-q068) assigned in the original source file's row order. Not present in the source file; added for public release.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The literal search query text, in its original language (English, Chinese, or mixed). Not translated or altered.

fields.name: primary_scene
fields.description: Primary use-case scene the query was curated to represent (brand, marketing/e-commerce, education, cultural-creative).

fields.name: secondary_scene
fields.description: Secondary use-case scene, if applicable.

fields.name: query_style
fields.description: Free-text descriptor of query style (e.g. 'Pinterest-like', 'Canva-template-like').

fields.name: expected_content_type
fields.description: Free-text description of the expected result content type.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Curation priority tier assigned when the gold set was selected.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Analyst confidence in the query's selection rationale.

fields.name: keep_or_review
fields.description: Whether the query was flagged for further review during curation.

fields.name: planned_test_type
fields.description: The type of search behavior this query was designed to probe.

fields.name: selected_reason
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) analyst rationale for including this query.

fields.name: likely_recall_challenge
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) hypothesis about recall difficulty for this query.

fields.name: likely_filtering_challenge
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) hypothesis about filtering/precision difficulty for this query.

fields.name: content_gap_hypothesis
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) hypothesis about content-catalog gaps for this query.

fields.name: query_id
fields.description: Foreign key to queries.csv query_id.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The literal search query text (redundant with queries.csv, kept for standalone readability).

fields.name: search_url
fields.description: The Curify search URL executed for this query.

fields.name: page_loaded
fields.description: Whether the search results page loaded successfully during automated collection.

fields.name: login_wall
fields.description: Whether a login wall blocked automated collection.

fields.name: visible_result_count
fields.description: Number of results visible on the page at collection time.

fields.name: top_10_result_titles
fields.description: Pipe-delimited titles of the top 10 results.

fields.name: top_10_result_tags_or_labels
fields.description: Pipe-delimited tags/labels attached to the top 10 results.

fields.name: top_10_result_types
fields.description: Pipe-delimited content type (e.g. inspiration, template) of the top 10 results.

fields.name: no_result_text
fields.description: Any 'no results' / 'showing broadened results' message text shown by the search UI.

fields.name: auto_flags
fields.description: Semicolon-delimited automated flags raised during collection (e.g. query_broadened_by_curify).

fields.name: needs_human_review
fields.description: Whether the automated collector flagged this row for human review.

fields.name: claude_relevance_label
fields.description: First-pass relevance label generated by an LLM (Claude) reading the automated collection output. This is NOT a human judgment.

fields.name: claude_issue_type
fields.description: Semicolon-delimited categorical issue tags assigned by the LLM (e.g. bad_relevance, wrong_decomposition, zero_result).

fields.name: claude_relevance_reason
fields.description: Free-text LLM-generated explanation for the relevance label.

fields.name: claude_confidence
fields.description: LLM's self-reported confidence in its own label.

fields.name: recommended_manual_review_priority
fields.description: Priority tier the LLM recommended for a (never-completed) human follow-up review.
